Before you build

Launch on Xeris

Clear mechanics, exact amounts, and a distinction between curve trading and the graduated pool.

01 / Creation

A native token identity

Each launchpad creates a protocol-managed token with 9 decimals. Creation requires a signed transaction, a base native-XRS fee and a fee for retained metadata.

The local form does not deploy a contract or reserve an ID.

02 / Curve trading

A curve, before the pool

Curve buys spend wrapped XRS; sells return wrapped XRS. Native XRS is needed separately for network fees.

Curve fees: 1% creator + 0.77% protocol.

03 / Graduation

Liquidity for the next stage

When the liquidity target is reached, an eligible curve can graduate to a generic DEX pool. Initial graduated LP ownership belongs to the protocol, not automatically the creator.

Graduated pools charge 0.3% LP fees. Curve creator fees do not continue on those swaps.

Data / Trust

Published data, with limits

This beta verifies a fixed mainnet checkpoint, then reads a fresh launchpad-token feed. It displays unavailable states when identity, coverage or freshness checks fail.

Displayed valuations use verified circulating supply and pool pricing when available. Incomplete or expired snapshots are shown as unavailable.

Mainnet Beta scope

Discovery and local preview are available.

Token creation, buying, selling, graduation, reward claims and wallet signing are not enabled on this website.
